name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 5 No 19

clue.text: No chum is ragged to such a degree
In an anxious state, having been suspended
Took off commercial about keep-fit exercises
Timorous person, eager to acquire the skill
A punch that’s thrown correctly
Old festival, with wine drawn, reportedly
The young lady’s a beauty, they say, making debut in House?
See 15
Man going round beat smelling of cloves?
Not many, we hear, taking English Channel back, being tense
What a calculator needs? Time chart, I fancy
Disguise a poet’s depression, by the sound of it
Strong malt liquor fools rejected, given leave
Produce, having the means, a raised path
Kind of hat visible in photo-margin
Self-service counter offering small slice of cod with stale batter
See 2
Bird giving a wave
Tennis net I damaged, all unaware
Coated — in mink?
Hospital crew achieves eminence
Drastic device in Commons, with group elected trapped by deception
Once teased, I’m looking up on getting a eulogy
Badgered, out East, to take on an old vixen
It’s sacredly symbolic — goodness! — receiving cane endlessly
A salt with a superior rank
Three-cornered capes wanted, if such can be woven
Called upon when not having to sit, competed
